# ycxx.lex: translation phases 1–3, 5 and 6 (#40). The Unicode tables and unicode_names.txt are
# generated by tools/unicode/gen-tables.
add_library(ycxxc_lex STATIC)
target_sources(ycxxc_lex PUBLIC FILE_SET CXX_MODULES FILES
  lex.cppm tok.cppm builtins.cppm unicode_tables.cppm unicode.cppm diag.cppm source.cppm lexer.cppm literal.cppm)
target_link_libraries(ycxxc_lex PUBLIC ycxxc_engine)
set_property(SOURCE unicode.cppm APPEND PROPERTY OBJECT_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/unicode_names.txt)
